title: Multi-Channel Product Listing Quality & SKU Audit Matrix
summary: Repeatable quality-control audit checklist for multi-channel product listings utilizing nested IF and COUNTIF formulas to systematically flag incomplete attributes and missing imagery.
problem: Multi-channel e-commerce stores frequently publish incomplete listings with missing attributes, unverified prices, or poor imagery, leading to suppressed search rankings and lower conversion rates.
whatIDid: Constructed an SKU-level quality-control audit matrix covering title presence, description completeness, image checks, price verification, category mapping, and attribute accuracy.
Integrated standardized data validation dropdown fields (Yes/No checks and High/Medium/Low priority tags) to prevent inconsistent auditing inputs.
Engineered automated nested IF/COUNTIF logic to dynamically trigger listing statuses (=IF(COUNTIF(C:H,"No")>=3,"Needs Major Update",IF(COUNTIF(C:H,"No")>=1,"Needs Review","Ready for QA"))).
Configured soft conditional formatting badges and actionable next-step recommendations to streamline copy and asset revisions.
result: Created a systematic QA workflow that replaces manual ad-hoc checks, immediately prioritizing high-risk SKUs and ensuring zero listings go live with missing critical data.
